name: 91770 · Rosemead, CA
findings: ZIP 91770 (Rosemead) has 176 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91770 (Rosemead) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91770 (Rosemead) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
